fullContentHtml:
Railway RRB JE CBT I Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released Exam Date for the recruitment of Junior Engineer JE, CMA & DMS on the official website of the RRBs. This recruitment was released for 4029 posts. Applications for the RRB Junior Engineer JE Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 14 August 2026 to 13 September 2026. The CBT-I examination is going to conducted on 27, 28 & 30 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Railway RRB JE CBT I Exam Date 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 14 August 2026
  • Last Date for Apply : 13 September 2026
  • Last Date Fee Payment : 15 September 2026
  • Form Correction / Modified Date : 16-25 September 2026
  • Application Status : Notify Soon
  • Exam Date : 27, 28 & 30 October 2026
  • Exam City Details : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Notify Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 400/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
